title: The fixed Koszul and quotient reconstruction models
statement: For the completed coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], retain the actual module sheaf category, ordinary strict quotient tower, total derived inverse limit, and explicit Koszul mapping fibre of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. The residue-normalized quotient maps determine the ordinary unit. The universal left-derived reduction pair and total right-derived limit determine a unique completion unit on K-flat representatives. The explicit Koszul fibre is functorial, preserves quasi-isomorphisms, and localizes with its original degree-zero unit. This node only records the existing constructions and supporting proofs formerly in the reconstruction module; it introduces no new choices or changed definitions.

proof.text: For reconstructionTowers_grothendieck, use the independent-universe module-sheaf Grothendieck theorem. Evaluation left adjoints applied to a separator give a separating family for strict towers; filtered colimits and AB5 are pointwise. Inverse-limit additivity follows by all projections.

Construct reconstructionQuotientUnit by the unit/global-sections equivalence using the compatible section 1. Its residue formula gives transition compatibility. The compatible tensor maps define reconstructionOrdinaryUnit by the strict inverse-limit cone, naturally in the module; joint monicity gives uniqueness. The K-flat computation clause of the chosen derived reduction pair proves reconstructionTowerCounit_isIso.

For reconstructionCompletionUnit_exists, the K-flat resolving full subcategory of the homotopy category is right-fraction dense and its restriction of Qh is a localization. Whiskering along it is fully faithful. Compose the natural ordinary-unit/right-derived-limit comparison with the inverse derived-reduction counit on that subcategory, and descend this natural transformation. The localization factor isomorphisms yield exactly the existing complex normalization. This also proves uniqueness on all K-flat representatives. The generic DerivedReductionModelData record retains the same chosen pair and avoids expanding coefficient definitions in the kernel.

Tensor interchange and product projections prove reconstructionKoszulProductMap_comm. The mapArrowHom identity and composition laws, followed by the shift functor, prove the corresponding fibre-map laws. The actual Koszul unit is natural by tensor interchange and the explicit cofiber inclusion. Localization factorization and liftNatTrans_app give reconstructionKoszulIntrinsicComparison, preserving its unit.

For reconstructionKoszulFiberFunctor_inverts, the actual completed exterior Koszul complexes are K-flat. Tensoring by each factor therefore preserves quasi-isomorphisms. Exact countable products of pro-etale module sheaves imply that homology preserves the product, so the product map is a quasi-isomorphism. Identify mapArrowHom with the mapping-cone map, use two-out-of-three for its distinguished triangle after Q, and shift by -1. Hence Q inverts the recorded fibre map.
